proof_mechanisms: 1. Start from parent_4 formula which had train_loss 5/2
2. Add correction terms floor(x0/2) - floor(x0/6) to fix systematic undershoot
claim.statement: Parent_4 had the best train loss (5/2) among task-affine parents. Its formula 1 + x0 + floor(x0^2/12) + floor(x0*(x0-1)*(x0-2)/180) systematically undershoots by a roughly linear amount. Adding floor(x0/2) - floor(x0/6) as periodic correction terms attempts to fix this. For x0=20: 1+20+floor(400/12)+floor(20*19*18/180)+10-3 = 1+20+33+38+10-3 = 99, but expected 72, so still off. Need different coefficients.
